svg.metadata: geoBoundaries gbOpen LIE ADM0 (shapeID 60073359B37148090091257); source OpenStreetMap/Wambacher; ODbL 1.0; WGS84; illustrated treatment: JOURNEY ATLAS

g.desc: GSHHG 2.3.6 intermediate-resolution sampling covers the entire aspect-fitted viewport as continuous inland land. Liechtenstein borders Switzerland and Austria; the pale full-frame context therefore represents surrounding foreign land while the approved Liechtenstein target remains dominant and unchanged.
